name: @hasna/estate-sync
description: Shared cloud-sync engine for the apps estate store bucket: push a digest bundle plus a signed index pointer, pull by resolving the signed index, fetching by digest, verifying sha256, and hydrating atomically. Parameterized by (estate bucket, app prefix).

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/cli/index.ts --outdir ./bin --target bun && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/sdk/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build

author: Hasna
